name: livetennisapi-scores
description: Live tennis scores and match state in your status bar — ATP, WTA, Challenger, ITF and juniors.

livetennis.enabled.description: Show live tennis scores in the status bar and poll for updates.

livetennis.tour.description: Which tour to follow. 'all' shows matches from every tour.

livetennis.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between refreshes. The default of 900 (15 minutes) keeps an always-on editor at ~96 requests/day, inside the free tier's 100 requests/day cap — 60s polling would spend 1,440/day, over 14x that cap. The floor is 60 (the free tier's 30 requests/minute budget); values below 60 are clamped up to 60. Always-on polling faster than every 15 minutes needs a BASIC key (1,000 requests/day).

livetennis.apiKey.markdownDescription: **Migration only — not storage.** A key entered here is moved into VS Code's encrypted SecretStorage on the next activation and this setting is then cleared automatically. Prefer the **Live Tennis: Set API Key** command. Keys left in `settings.json` are replicated by Settings Sync and are easily pasted into bug reports.
